rv.q: Directed by Jonathan Goodwin, Jamie Allan’s Amaze is astonishing.

In his aptly named Amaze, Jamie Allan relates his story of being raised by loving parents, discovering his life’s passion at an early age, and being lucky enough to pursue it and master it. The show is a touching coming-of-age tale, mixing humor and poignancy to wonderful effect, delivered with charm and wit.
Tricks aside, Allan is a charming and warm performer who welcomes the audience into sharing his love of this form of escapism.
Jamie Allan delivers mystery, memoir, and magic for all ages.
I did not leave with my jaw dropped but with a flicker of childhood wonder reignited, and a loving nod to the memories and mentors that taught me to find the extraordinary in the everyday.
If you love illusions, you will not want to miss Jamie Allan’s AMAZE!
This is a show that caters to everyone in the family, and it’s a show that certainly lives up to its ambitious title.

cn.t: Critics praise Jamie Allan's "Amaze" as a charming and impressive magic show that blends stunning illusions with heartfelt storytelling about the magician's journey, creating a family-friendly experience that enchants audiences with both technical skill and emotional resonance.
